forehead.region_description: Forehead down to the eyebrows,as the author explicitly bounds it.
forehead.historical_association: In Fragment II,Lavater assigned the forehead to his category 'intellectual life'. This is a historical assertion,not evidence about any observed person.
forehead.limitations: Region-only documentary lookup. Geometry,markings,side and proportions do not select a personal interpretation; the author's intelligence/morality/animal-life claims are not operationalized.

terms.description: Hunter's translation uses physiognomy for the proposed science and physionomy for outward appearance; this records terminology,not scientific endorsement.
Lavater contrasted fixed/resting form with features in motion,calling the latter pathognomy. No emotion,character or internal state is inferred by this engine.

lavater-v1-p265-figure-1.label: Volume I,p265,figure1
lavater-v1-p265-figure-1.description: Schematic1 shows a curved boundary with vertical,horizontal and diagonal construction lines; base widths differ across the three printed diagrams.
lavater-v1-p265-figure-1.orientation: Abstract forehead/quadrant schematic,not a frontal face or anatomical left/right claim.
lavater-v1-p265-figure-1.historical_context: Lavater used these constructions to argue for ranking intellectual capacity from skull/forehead proportions. That discredited inference is documented here,not calculated or applied to a person.

conventions.scope: Historical region/terminology lookup; no individualized physiognomic assessment.
conventions.orientation: Software annotation convention,not a Lavater formula: view left_profile means anatomical left side visible. Subject-side labels remain anatomical; frontal viewer labels swap under nonmirrored display and agree under mirrored display. Unknown mirroring remains ambiguous. Profile viewer labels cannot determine anatomical side.
conventions.coordinates: Optional normalized annotation points: x,y in[0,1]. Canonical subject-frame x increases toward anatomical right. Frontal nonmirrored viewer x maps to1-x; mirrored x maps tox. Profile projection is not normalized into a frontal face.
conventions.geometry: User descriptive enums and schematic annotations only; no thresholds,feature detection or geometry-to-trait rules.
conventions.tradition_isolation: No Chinese Mian Xiang,five-element,12-palace,Bridges or Holcroft mappings are borrowed.

research_cutoff: Yap Palaces & Positions product page and Elsevier Bridges contents inspected,without procedural diagrams; not used as rule evidence. Verified bounded original Lavater pages/figures sufficient; unavailable modern methods deferred.
unsupported: Automatic facial localization,biometric identification or photography input
Numerical physiognomic angles/ratios as ability scores
